compat.workshop_utilities.book_how: Get it from the Upgrade Enchanting Table, then apply it with the Upgrade Table.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.uncraftin: Put an item or block in the input slot to see the ingredients it was crafted from, like a crafting table in reverse.
Taking an ingredient uses as many input items as the recipe produces (for example 4 planks give back 1 log), then you can take everything.
If the item has several recipes, use the < and > buttons under the input slot. Hold Shift to skip 10 at a time.
Recipes from other mods work too if they use normal shaped or shapeless crafting. Special recipes and recipes that leave items behind are skipped.
A Backpack must be emptied before it can be uncrafted.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.disenchan: Put an enchanted item in the top slot to get the same item back without its enchantments.
Add a Book in the lower slot to also receive an enchanted book holding all the removed enchantments.
Mixing vanilla and mod enchantments gives a Fused Enchanted Book, which only the Upgrade Table can apply.
Survival and Adventure players earn XP levels from the removed enchantments; Creative players do not. Like a grindstone, it can sit on floors, walls and ceilings.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.upgrade_t: Left slot: the item or Backpack. Right slot: the material. Bottom slot: an Upgrade Tool. The result is only a preview until you take it.
Enchant: use a mod enchanted book or a Fused Enchanted Book. Every enchantment in the book is applied and the item keeps its other enchantments. Mod enchantments can no longer be applied at an Anvil.
Upgrade Backpack: use a Backpack and 8 of its tier material (Iron Ingot, Gold Ingot, Diamond or Netherite Ingot). You get the next tier with the same contents, name and enchantments.
Each upgrade uses 1 Upgrade Tool and costs no XP. Like an anvil, it falls when unsupported and hurts what it lands on.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.upgrade_e: Needs at least 20 bookshelves around it. The current count is shown in its GUI.
Put an Upgrade Book and an Upgrade Enchanted in its slots, then click the enchanted book you want.
Each Upgrade Book costs 15 XP levels (free in Creative). The output slot must be empty.
With more than 3 choices, scroll the list with the mouse wheel. Hold Shift over an enchanted book to read what it does.
A crafting ingredient for the Upgrade Table and the Upgrade Tool. It is also required, together with an Upgrade Book, in the Upgrade Enchanting Table.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.upgrade_b: Use it with an Upgrade Enchanted in the Upgrade Enchanting Table to get the mod enchanted book of your choice (15 XP levels).
compat.workshop_utilities.info.upgrade_t: One Upgrade Tool is used up for every upgrade in the Upgrade Table, for both enchanting and Backpack upgrades.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.fused_enc: Made by the Dis-Enchanting Table from items with both vanilla and mod enchantments. It has no recipe, and only the Upgrade Table can apply it (every enchantment on it).
Only the Small Backpack can be crafted and uncrafted. Bigger tiers come from the Upgrade Table. Slots: Small 36, Normal 63, Medium 80, Big 110, Huge 144.
Right-click to open. Sneak + right-click, or drag it into the Backpack slot of your inventory, to wear it on your back next to a chestplate and an Elytra.
Press B (changeable in Controls) to open a worn Backpack without taking it off.
Modules go into the Backpack's module slots and add features such as crafting, smelting or sleeping.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.crafting_: Put it in a Backpack module slot to craft from inside the Backpack.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.furnace_m: Put it in a Backpack module slot to smelt items from inside the Backpack.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.blast_fur: Put it in a Backpack module slot to blast ores from inside the Backpack.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.smoker_mo: Put it in a Backpack module slot to smoke food from inside the Backpack.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.uncraftin: Put it in a Backpack module slot to use the Uncrafting Table (input, recipe choice and 3x3 grid) from inside the Backpack.
compat.workshop_utilities.info.bed_modul: Goes in a side module slot (left of the Backpack GUI). Its Sleep button skips the night without a bed and without changing your spawn point.
gui.workshop_utilities.panel.backpack.no: No backpack worn. Sneak + right-click a backpack to wear it.
gui.workshop_utilities.backpack.tools.ne: Put a Tools Holder Module in the left slot below the Bed Module
compat.workshop_utilities.info.tools_hol: Goes in the side module slot below the Bed Module (left of the Backpack GUI). Adds 7 slots for tools, weapons and similar items, which can be shown or hidden with the button under the module.
